name: triage-bug-report
description: Walk through a bug report with structured form collection and a judgment step that produces a prioritised triage summary.

inputs.name: description
inputs.description: Steps to reproduce and observed behaviour

steps.description: Review the report and assign a triage priority.

steps.run:
set -o pipefail; jq -r '
  "## Triage Summary\n" +
  "**Title:** " + ((."collect-report".title // "(untitled)") | tostring) + "\n" +
  "**Reporter:** " + ((.inputs.reporter // "unknown") | tostring) + "\n" +
  "**Severity (self-reported):** " + ((."collect-report".severity // "?") | tostring) + "\n" +
  "**Priority (triaged):** " + ((."assess-priority".priority // "?") | tostring) + "\n" +
  "**Rationale:** " + ((."assess-priority".rationale // "?") | tostring) + "\n" +
  if ((."collect-report".component // "") | tostring) != "" then
    "**Component:** " + ((."collect-report".component // "") | tostring)
  else empty end
' <<< "$OSL_CONTEXT" | jq -Rs '{triage_summary: .}'
